zechariah.10.p1.b1.text: Ask the LORD for rain in springtime; the LORD makes the storm clouds, and He will give everyone showers of rain and crops in the field.

zechariah.10.p1.b2.text: For idols speak deceit and diviners see illusions … Therefore the people wander like sheep, oppressed for lack of a shepherd.

zechariah.10.p1.b3.text: For the LORD of Hosts attends to His flock, the house of Judah; He will make them like His royal steed in battle. … The cornerstone will come from Judah, the tent peg from him, as well as the battle bow

zechariah.10.p1.b4.text: I will whistle for them to gather, for I have redeemed them … I will bring them back from Egypt and gather them from Assyria. I will bring them to Gilead and Lebanon …

zechariah.10.p1.b5.text: They will pass through the sea of distress and strike the waves of the sea; all the depths of the Nile will dry up. … I will strengthen them in the LORD, and in His name they will walk
